description: This source file is a Spring MVC REST Controller named ShopProductRESTController that provides various RESTful endpoints for managing products, manufacturers, product options, product reviews, and related entities in an e-commerce application. It handles actions such as creating, deleting, and retrieving products, as well as managing product options, reviews, and manufacturer data, with access control based on merchant store codes.

classes.name: ShopProductRESTController
classes.description: A Spring MVC REST Controller that manages CRUD operations for products, manufacturers, product options, product reviews, and product listing by categories and filters in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product associated with a specified merchant store, populating the Product entity from the PersistableProduct data and saving it via productService.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product by its ID if it belongs to the specified merchant store.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer associated with a merchant store, populates the entity, and saves it.

methods.name: createProductOptionValue
methods.description: Creates a new product option value, linking it to the specified merchant store.

methods.name: createProductOption
methods.description: Creates a new product option for a merchant store.

methods.name: createProductReview
methods.description: Adds a new review for a product, ensuring no duplicate review exists from the same customer and that the rating does not exceed the maximum allowed.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products for a category within a store, supporting language selection and category lineage filtering.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Provides filtered product listings based on criteria such as brand, with support for pagination.
